description: Search California cities and licensed senior living and care providers by name. Use when the user names a provider or a California place. Returns matching cities with provider counts and matching providers with their Later Stages URLs. Covers California only. Read-only public records; no prices, availability or reviews.

query.description: A provider name or the California place the user is asking about, e.g. "Irvine" or "Sunrise of". Not the user's own location.

name: search_senior_care
title: Search cities and providers
